1.title: Fired Journalists From Stars and Stripes Sue Pentagon
1.summary: Three journalists dismissed from Stars and Stripes accused the government of violating their First Amendment rights, asking the courts to stop their termination.

2.title: White House Construction May Have Contributed to Close Call With Trump’s Helicopter
2.summary: A controller let a jet take off after missing warnings that Marine One was about to fly through the area, according to the National Transportation Safety Board.

3.title: In Trump’s Washington, Ballooning National Debt Stirs Little Action
3.summary: The relative indifference to the news that the U.S. government now owes $40 trillion demonstrates how drastically the politics of deficit spending has changed.

4.title: Live Updates: Rescuers Search for Missing and Stranded Under Threat of More Floods
4.summary: Officials said hundreds were killed in Nepal and Tibet, and more than 1,400 people are missing. Stunned witnesses described a torrent of debris and water carrying away villages in minutes.

5.title: Yielding on French Could Restart Trade Talks, Canadian Officials Say
5.summary: Canada’s minister in charge of trade with the U.S. was responding to comments by Jamieson Greer, the U.S. trade representative. But that was before any mention of Lake Ontario.

6.title: Trump signs order to rename Lake Ontario as Lake America
6.summary: Trump's order comes after the trade talks between the US and Canada collapsed late last week.
